# Fixtures from filecoin-pin

`big.fee`, `report.fee`, and `share-link-vectors.json` are copied unchanged from [filecoin-pin](https://github.com/filecoin-project/filecoin-pin) at commit `b1fd672f8ff0b61975c3d0adfe2fbec07b087773` on the `feat/encryption-v2` branch, from `src/test/fixtures/`. The golden Grant and the Grant inputs in `../keys.ts` come from `src/test/unit/group-key-grant.test.ts` and `src/test/fixtures/group-key-grants.ts` at the same commit.
